svg.title: Eventiva layer 2, group 3
svg.desc: Prerequisite arrows point toward dependent issues. Layers are derived, not approved dates. Labels and border patterns distinguish completed, current, upcoming, closed and blocked work. Every node links to its live issue; Markdown provides full titles, prerequisites and unlocks.
svg.text: Derived layers; not deadlines or acceptance.
Blocked overrides fill/border; current keeps double.

a.aria-label: EVE-252: Implement Effect Cluster sharding and multi-runner recovery in the fresh Eventiva backend. CURRENT / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2 prerequisites; 1 unlocks. Layer 2.
a.title: EVE-252: Implement Effect Cluster sharding and multi-runner recovery in the fresh Eventiva backend. CURRENT / BLOCKED. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2 prerequisites; 1 unlocks. Layer 2.

a.aria-label: EVE-257: Implement the composable module kernel and safe lifecycle/provider contracts. CURRENT. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2026-11-17: later-status: Batch 5 slice 1 preserves private admitted kernel manifests across register return values, fresh authority views and staged updates. Red-first public regressions reproduce missing-dependency bypass, renamed-scope leakage and retained authority replacement corruption: seven fail on unchanged production source while all 39 existing tests and three new controls pass. The private typed manifest copy and captured disposal key leave contracts, executable Layers and provider service values unchanged. Focused kernel/telemetry and two-dialect producer checks pass; final latest-main aggregate verification and signed delivery are recorded separately in the timeline and owning issue. EVE-257 remains In Progress; in-process alias isolation is not distributed fencing, durable registry reconstruction, production activation or complete platform acceptance. The historical issue capture is unchanged. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-257#comment-b21e1a9b-d224-416a-bd29-a85d3e81ac38, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-7fb29ae7-0008-4ec1-81c5-7078270fe066. 2 prerequisites; 4 unlocks. Layer 2.

a.aria-label: EVE-258: Add the database-neutral Resources API and privileged tenant migration adapter. CURRENT. Captured Linear: In Progress. 2026-11-17: later-status: Slice 1 adds a separate self-asserting declaration migration process-loss target to storage test, preserving the held parent spec and its migrationCrashProof:false default report. SQLite and disposable PostgreSQL pass precommit SIGKILL rollback, postcommit acknowledgement loss, empty repeat history, valid changed-prefix refusal and stale-writer rejection with a current-writer control. Separately, batch 4 slice 2 reproduces caller-owned declaration aliasing in the existing EVE-23 host and detaches admitted resource/contribution metadata and returned schema views. Its focused host/execution and schema controls pass; combined gates and signed delivery are recorded separately on the issues and timeline. Jonathan's option B, relayed through Puck on 2026-11-17 with exact selection time unknown, permits auto-added Amp-Thread-ID and generic Amp coauthor trailers as a standing attribution-only exception; model-specific credit, Jonathan's sign-off and all other gates remain required. EVE-23's completed status is unchanged. This is bounded in-process registry and local G04 evidence, not canonical storage integration, power loss, distributed fencing, native execution, production least privilege or whole-issue acceptance. Source capture remains historical; later execution and delivery evidence is cited separately. Sources: https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258/add-the-database-neutral-resources-api-and-privileged-tenant-migration#comment-79bf922f, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-a0a1608d-284c-46c6-8bd0-372ce1a02efb, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258#comment-c32dee12, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23#comment-4bee9f1d, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1ea75-2cdd-758c-aa90-a1e5ba6ba432, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-258#comment-585506ae, https://linear.app/resnovas/issue/EVE-23#comment-5b25448f, https://ampcode.com/threads/T-01a1e940-37a3-7691-a5c0-e935b711c99a. 2 prerequisites; 3 unlocks. Layer 2.
